Run 1/3 was spent by w12 hub/single-design-crossover (2026-09-21T12:53:06Z) and runs 2/3 and 3/3 by w12b hub/nr6-and-kstar (2026-09-21T21:33:51Z), the latter explicitly to 'add seeds 1 and 2 at K* = 32 on TEST'. control_gate.rule: NO STORE ROW IS CLAIMED unless landscape_removed, landscape_shuffled, landscape_shuffled_across_wells and random_atoms ALL collapse on EVERY seed. A control that collapsed at seed 0 is NOT assumed to collapse at seeds 1 and 2 -- it is measured at each.
control_gate.collapse_definition: the control's distinct_valid_novel_tuples per corner reads 0.0000 against the arm, and the paired estimand beats the 1.0 margin on every corner
control_gate.consequence: store rows ARE claimable at n = 3

deletion_rows.exactness_definition: STORE-SCOPED: downdate(delete rows) equals the store fitted from scratch without those rows, at the same partition and the same rank. THE FROZEN ENCODER AND THE FROZEN DECODER ARE DECLARED OUTSIDE THE DELETABLE OBJECT AND ARE NOT REFIT.
deletion_rows.adaptation_language: post-deletion adaptation is LIGHT and DATA-FREE -- the covariance and count are downdated by subtraction, the atoms are re-eigendecomposed from the downdated statistic, the address book is carried across the basis change, and NO ROW OF DATA IS READ. It is never 'no changes'.
deletion_rows.rival_deletion_rule: A RIVAL DELETES ONLY BY RETRAIN-WITHOUT, and its cost is printed. Rival as-trained is printed beside it and is NOT a deletion mechanism.
